description: raw-recurrence-v7 with evaluations sized for the eval budget. Evaluations sized for the owner's budget (2026-10-10: all evaluations ~3% of a stage's wall time, 5% ceiling): the text stages evaluate 8 held documents per cohort (was 16; first and last window each) (lines with a behaviour gate, e.g. raw-recurrence-mellum-v8, also evaluate the precision gate columns on the first 8 held documents via quantization.gate.column_held_documents). Together with the on-device weights fingerprint (a host SHA-256 of 23 GB took ~3.5 of ~4.2 min per evaluation) this targets ~3%; the trainer's logged eval_share shows the real share. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.
